purpose: proposed disposable restricted-alpha delivery diagnostic; no live release
budget_scope: all RunLater resources and prior diagnostics in the same billing month

resource_names.sqlite_namespace: fresh ProjectIdentity namespace attached to runlater-alpha-api

identity.local_private_key_disposition: delete after cleanup; never upload or print

grant.id: unique campaign ID chosen after inventory

callback_material.storage: supported secure Wrangler secret input from private local file/pipe; never GitHub, messages or config vars
callback_material.disposition: remove both Worker secrets and private files with disposable resources

residual_risks: provider billing unit rounding and prior monthly usage
anonymous public ingress not globally capped
transport duplicates not capped by configured max_retries
estimates do not certify provider costs
tests: scheduled alarm/Queue v2 success and rotation cutover
bounded timeout then cancel if time permits
skip_policy: four tasks total; choose retry or redirect/timeout subsets to stay within four tasks, skip remaining tests before cleanup deadline
cleanup_identity_rule: capture returned script names, Queue ID, namespace ID, domain IDs and preexisting inventory in private resource ledger; delete only exact created identities; uncertain creates require inventory reconciliation before retry
cleanup_order: revoke configured synthetic identities, grant and callback keys while services are controlled
remove created custom domains/records by returned ID
delete created Workers and Queue by captured identity
delete fresh SQLite namespace by captured ID
verify scripts/domains/Queue/namespace absent and original inventory preserved
